name: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)
notes: The twelve PCI DSS requirements, scoped to what an IaC stack can evidence for the cardholder data environment (CDE). Scoping/segmentation of the CDE drives everything. Not a substitute for a QSA assessment.

requirements.name: Network security controls
requirements.description: Install and maintain network security controls between trusted and untrusted networks and around the CDE.
infra_signals: dedicated VPC/VNet or subnets for the CDE
security groups / NSGs default-deny
no direct internet route to CDE data stores
documented segmentation from non-CDE workloads

requirements.name: Secure configurations
requirements.description: Apply secure configurations to all system components; no vendor defaults.
infra_signals: hardened AMIs/images
no default passwords or accounts in IaC
unused services and ports disabled
config baseline enforcement (Config rules, Azure Policy)

requirements.name: Protect stored account data
requirements.description: Protect stored account data; render PAN unreadable anywhere it is stored.
infra_signals: encryption at rest with customer-managed keys on CDE stores
key rotation enabled
tokenization service or field-level encryption
no PAN in logs or object storage without controls

requirements.name: Protect data in transit
requirements.description: Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks.
infra_signals: TLS 1.2+ enforced on all public endpoints
strong cipher policies on load balancers
certificates managed and auto-renewed

requirements.name: Malware protection
requirements.description: Protect all systems and networks from malicious software.
infra_signals: endpoint/workload protection on VMs (Defender, GuardDuty runtime, etc.)
container image scanning in the pipeline

requirements.name: Secure systems and software
requirements.description: Develop and maintain secure systems and software; manage vulnerabilities and changes.
infra_signals: patch automation (SSM Patch Manager, Update Manager)
CI/CD with review gates
WAF protecting public web apps
dependency and IaC scanning in the pipeline

requirements.name: Restrict access by need to know
requirements.description: Restrict access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know.
infra_signals: least-privilege IAM roles scoped to CDE resources
separate roles per duty (deploy vs operate vs audit)

requirements.name: Identify users and authenticate access
requirements.description: Identify users and authenticate access to system components; MFA for all access into the CDE.
infra_signals: MFA enforced for console and CDE access
unique identities, no shared accounts
no long-lived static credentials

requirements.name: Restrict physical access
requirements.description: Restrict physical access to cardholder data.
infra_signals: inherited from the cloud provider's attestations (AOC) for provider-managed facilities

requirements.name: Log and monitor all access
requirements.description: Log and monitor all access to system components and cardholder data.
infra_signals: audit trail enabled on all CDE accounts
log integrity protection (locked buckets, immutability)
log retention >= 12 months (3 months hot)
time sync (NTP) consistent across components

requirements.name: Test security regularly
requirements.description: Test security of systems and networks regularly.
infra_signals: vulnerability scanning enabled
IaC drift detection
intrusion detection (GuardDuty, Defender, IDS) on CDE networks

requirements.name: Security policies and programs
requirements.description: Support information security with organizational policies and programs.
infra_signals: mostly organizational; IaC evidences it via tagging standards, ownership metadata, and documented environments
